title: Engineer - Wet Utilities
description:
We are seeking an Engineer with strong technical expertise in wet utilities design, covering water supply, wastewater, storm drainage, and urban drainage systems. The role involves supporting design deliverables from concept through detailed design, working closely with senior engineers and CAD modellers, and ensuring compliance with Swedish/Nordic codes and standards.


  
* **Wet utilities design:** Assist in design of water, wastewater, storm drainage, and urban drainage systems.
* **Civil3D modelling support:** Prepare and update 3D models for wet and dry utilities under guidance of senior engineers.
* **Design basis preparation:** Contribute to establishing design criteria and methodologies.
* **Hydraulic calculations:** Support preparation of hydraulic layouts and calculations.
* **Documentation:** Produce drawings, specifications, and reports for tender and construction stages.
* **Coordination:** Work collaboratively with CAD staff, engineers, and cross‑discipline teams.
* **Compliance:** Apply Swedish/Nordic codes and standards in design deliverables.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 4–8 years of professional experience in wet utilities design.
* Proficiency in **Civil3D** for utility modelling.
* Exposure to **concept to detailed design delivery** .
* Knowledge of **Swedish/Nordic codes and standards** (ISO, SSG, SIS).
* Experience in **stormwater management** and **urban drainage design** .
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow design instructions.
* Good communication skills for coordination with teams and clients.

  
**Preferred Attributes**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (Master’s in Water Resources/Environmental Engineering desirable).
* Experience in multidisciplinary project environments.
* Ability to adapt to new tools and workflows.
* Team‑oriented mindset with willingness to learn from senior colleagues.

title: Fire Technician
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced **Fire Fighting Technician** to join our team. The technician will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing, and repair of fire fighting systems, including sprinklers, fire pumps, hydrants, hose reels, and suppression systems in residential, commercial, and industrial facilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Install fire fighting systems as per drawings and specifications.
* Maintain and repair fire pumps, piping networks, sprinkler heads, hose reels, fire extinguishers, and valves.
* Conduct routine inspections and testing of fire protection systems to ensure proper functionality and code compliance.
* Identify faults and troubleshoot fire fighting system issues efficiently.
* Work with supervisors and engineers to implement system upgrades or modifications.
* Ensure proper documentation of inspections, tests, and maintenance performed.
* Follow safety procedures and ensure compliance with local fire safety regulations.
* Coordinate with other MEP teams during project execution.

**Requirements:**

* Strong knowledge of fire pumps, sprinkler systems, hydrants, wet and dry risers, and other fire protection systems.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and system schematics.
* Familiarity with NFPA standards and local fire code regulations.
* Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Physically fit and able to work at heights or in confined spaces.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Fire Fighting Technician certification or vocational training.
* Experience in high\-rise buildings, hospitals, or industrial projects.
* Valid safety training certifications (e.g., Work at Heights, Confined Space Entry).

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Greater Noida): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* fire technician: 2 years (Required)
